intent: An actionable setup checklist with a drawn completion ring, expandable instructions and native checkboxes, designed for thoughtful first-run experiences.

layout.direction: Preserve the focused setup checklist: a 64px drawn completion ring beside a 30px Instrument Serif heading, 14px task titles and instructions, generous ruled task rows and a quiet completion footer. Use 12px mono duration labels and the embedded checkbox kit with #737373 unchecked boundaries, at least 3:1 in both neutral themes. Checkbox completion and instruction disclosure are separate 44px targets.
layout.container: Size to the parent with @container. Keep the root width at 100%, capped to the focused component, with 24px desktop and 16px narrow padding.

motion.entrance: Enter the whole checklist with opacity and an 8px rise over 320ms. Draw the ring from empty over 400ms after a 160ms initial delay; later completion changes animate in either direction without that delay.
motion.interaction: Use the embedded checkbox hover, press, focus and checkmark treatment. Rotate the active instruction chevron over 150ms.
motion.reduced: Subscribe to live prefers-reduced-motion changes. Stop and settle the owned card/ring controls immediately; the checkbox kit removes transforms and checkmark travel.

responsive.rules: Wrap long copy; stack secondary details inside narrow containers; keep any horizontal scrolling local and keyboard accessible.

accessibility: Use native buttons and form controls with visible 2px focus rings.
Provide labels, meaningful states and polite feedback where actions update content.
Keep IDs instance-scoped with useId; support multiple instances and empty custom data.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; no automatic action or navigation.

content.defaults: Use the realistic default content from the source; expose content and collection inputs as typed props.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting setup guidance, independent of task count.

props.name: tasks
props.description: Ordered tasks with stable unique IDs, titles, descriptions and host-supplied estimated duration labels.

props.name: completed
props.description: Controlled completed task IDs. Completion is read-only without onChange; instructions remain available. Only available task IDs count or reach notifications.

props.name: defaultCompleted
props.description: Initial local completed IDs, normalized to known tasks and deduplicated.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Synchronous completion notification with an independent array of known IDs after explicit check/uncheck. The host owns controlled acknowledgement and any external setup work.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.

avoid: Remote images, fake network success or hidden external dependencies.
Decorative status badges, gradients as filler, low-contrast text.
Unlabelled controls, hover-only functionality, overflow at 320px.
contract: Keep SetupTask and SetupChecklistProps. Use stable unique task IDs as React keys so reordering retains focused checkbox/disclosure DOM and open instructions.

Use defaultCompleted for a local draft or completed with onChange for host control. Filter completion IDs to available tasks and deduplicate them. Required external setup work remains the host responsibility; checking a row only updates completion state.

Pass an independent completion array to onChange synchronously. A host callback cannot mutate the stored local draft. Controlled completion without a writer is disabled while instruction disclosures remain active.

Keep the ring, visible count, accessible count and written footer consistent with actual checked rows. A refused controlled proposal must not appear complete. Support check and uncheck, singular remaining-step copy, all-complete and no-configured-tasks states.

Keep one instruction disclosure open at a time, with aria-expanded and instance-scoped aria-controls. Native Enter and Space activate buttons and checkboxes. Expose completion feedback through a polite status.
Accept empty and arriving task lists, long descriptions and independent instances without overflow or ID collisions. Duration values are host display labels, without parsing or external operations.
